title: Card Payment Authorization
description: The Payment Service shall authorise card payments against the acquirer, capture an authorisation code and persist the transaction with its currency, amount and merchant reference.

title: Payment Validation Rules Engine
description: The Payment Validator shall validate amount, currency code, merchant configuration and payment instrument before any authorisation call, returning a deterministic list of validation errors.

title: Unsupported Currency Rejection
description: Payment requests carrying a currency code outside the merchant's supported currency list shall be rejected with error UNSUPPORTED_CURRENCY before funds are reserved.

title: Multi Currency Payment Processing
description: The platform shall accept payments in every enabled settlement currency, converting to the merchant settlement currency using the rate effective at authorisation time and storing both amounts.

title: Currency Conversion Rate Sourcing
description: The Currency Service shall refresh FX rates every 15 minutes from the treasury feed, cache them and expose the rate age with every conversion.

title: Payment Retry and Idempotency
description: Repeated submissions of the same idempotency key shall never create a second authorisation; the original transaction result is replayed.

title: Fraud Screening Threshold Enforcement
description: Transactions scoring above the configured fraud threshold shall be held for manual review, and cross-currency transactions shall be scored with the converted base-currency amount.

title: Transaction Ledger Consistency
description: Every captured payment and refund shall produce balanced double-entry ledger postings; the ledger shall reconcile to the transaction store daily.

title: Transaction Record Persistence and Retention
description: Transaction records shall persist amount, currency, converted amount, status and audit timestamps, and be retained for seven years.

title: Order Checkout Flow
description: The checkout journey shall validate the cart, reserve stock, request payment authorisation and confirm the order in a single orchestrated flow.

title: Order Total Calculation with Taxes
description: Order totals shall be computed as line items plus tax minus discounts, rounded per currency minor-unit rules before payment authorisation.

title: Order Cancellation
description: Customers shall cancel an order before dispatch; cancellation voids the authorisation or triggers a full refund when funds were captured.

title: Full and Partial Refund Processing
description: The Refund Service shall support full and partial refunds against a captured payment, never exceeding the remaining refundable amount.

title: Refund Currency Parity
description: Refunds shall be issued in the original transaction currency using the original conversion rate so that the customer is made whole.

title: Invoice Generation and Numbering
description: A gap-free, sequential invoice number shall be issued per legal entity on order completion, with amounts formatted for the invoice currency.

title: User Profile Management
description: Customers shall view and edit profile details, contact preferences and the address book from the profile page of the portal.

title: Multi-Factor Authentication
description: Sign-in from an unrecognised device and any high-value payment shall require a second authentication factor before the action completes.

title: Session Token Lifecycle
description: Access tokens shall expire after 30 minutes of inactivity, be renewable with a refresh token and be revoked immediately on password change.

title: Transactional Email Notifications
description: Order confirmation, refund confirmation and security alerts shall be delivered by templated email in the customer's locale within 60 seconds.

title: Financial Reconciliation Reporting
description: A daily reconciliation report shall summarise settled, refunded and pending amounts per currency for finance operations.

title: Depart Test key availability on Menu 1
description: When the parking function is not on and the I-ETMS penalty brake cut out switch is in the Cut In position and the locomotive airbrake system is indicating Air Brake Cut-In, and the on-board segment is in the ACTIVE, DISENGAGED or CUT OUT state and the locomotive is stopped, the on-board segment shall make a Depart Test key available on Menu 1.

title: Brake pipe pressure precondition for departure test
description: When the Depart Test key is pressed and the on-board segment state is ACTIVE or DISENGAGED and the on-board segment does not receive a valid feed valve setting status from the brake system and the front brake pipe pressure is less than TBC246 psi, the on-board segment shall display a 'Brake pipe pressure must be at least TBC246 PSI to begin departure test' prompt with a Cancel key.

title: Feed valve setting status validation
description: The on-board segment shall treat a feed valve setting status as valid only when it is received from the brake system within TBC118 seconds and is within the configured feed valve range.

title: Penalty brake cut out switch handling
description: When the I-ETMS penalty brake cut out switch transitions to the Cut Out position, the on-board segment shall transition to the CUT OUT state and shall annunciate the transition to the crew within TBC005 seconds.

title: Onboard segment state transitions
description: The on-board segment shall maintain the ACTIVE, DISENGAGED, CUT OUT and FAILED states and shall only transition between them on the conditions defined for each transition.

title: Departure test execution and result reporting
description: On completion of the departure test the on-board segment shall report a pass or fail result to the crew display and shall record the result for the back office.

title: Position determination initialisation
description: The on-board segment shall not declare position determined until the position determination system reports a valid position with an uncertainty below TBC030 feet.

title: Track database version validation
description: The on-board segment shall verify the track database version against the version advertised by the back office and shall enter DISENGAGED if the versions differ.

title: Wayside status message processing
description: The on-board segment shall process WIU status messages received over the 220 MHz data radio and shall treat a message older than TBC060 seconds as stale.

title: Crew display menu key layout
description: The on-board segment shall present Menu 1 soft keys in the defined order and shall grey out any key whose preconditions are not satisfied.

title: Stock Reservation at Checkout
description: The Inventory Service shall reserve stock for every line item before payment authorisation and shall release the reservation when authorisation fails or the order is cancelled.

title: Shipment Creation and Carrier Labels
description: The Shipping Service shall create a shipment for every paid order, select the carrier service for the delivery option and generate a carrier label within 5 minutes.

title: Product Price and Availability Display
description: The Product Catalog Service shall show the current price and stock availability on product pages, and availability shall not be older than 60 seconds.

title: Coupon and Promotion Limits
description: The Promotion Engine shall apply eligible coupons, enforce the per-order promotion limit and redeem each coupon exactly once per order.

title: Loyalty Points Accrual
description: The Loyalty Service shall award loyalty points only for completed orders and shall remove points when an order is cancelled or refunded.

title: Subscription Renewal Charging
description: The Subscription Billing Service shall charge each renewal in the plan currency and retry failed renewals on a schedule before suspending the subscription.

title: Wallet Balance Integrity
description: The Digital Wallet Service shall never allow a balance below zero, shall apply top-ups only after payment capture and shall post every balance movement to the ledger.

title: Chargeback Dispute Handling
description: The Chargeback Service shall submit dispute evidence before the scheme deadline and shall post each chargeback outcome to the ledger exactly once.

title: Merchant Payout Release
description: The Merchant Payout Service shall release payouts only to merchants with an approved KYC status and only for settled ledger balances.

title: Jurisdiction Tax Calculation
description: The Tax Calculation Service shall calculate tax by delivery jurisdiction, apply EU VAT rules for cross-border orders and round tax per invoice.

title: Merchant KYC Verification
description: The KYC Verification Service shall verify merchant identity documents, reject expired documents and re-verify merchants every 12 months.

title: Marketing Consent Enforcement
description: The Consent Management Service shall record marketing consent per channel, and no marketing message shall be sent after consent is withdrawn.

title: Security Audit Trail
description: The Audit Trail Service shall record every sign-in, MFA reset, permission change and admin action with actor, time and outcome.

title: Product Search Relevance
description: The Search Service shall return only products from enabled categories, tolerate one-letter typos and rank exact title matches first.

title: Mobile App Session Security
description: The Mobile App Backend shall revoke mobile sessions within 60 seconds of a password change and shall require step-up authentication for payments.

title: Ordered Payment Event Publishing
description: Payment events shall be published on the Event Broker in transaction order and delivered at least once to the ledger and reporting consumers.

title: Support Portal Refunds
description: The Customer Support Portal shall let agents raise full and partial refunds, using the shared refund validation and never exceeding the captured amount.

title: Nightly Finance Extract
description: The Finance Data Warehouse shall load a nightly extract of settled payments and refunds, counting each refund reversal once.

title: Gift Card Redemption
description: The Gift Card Service shall issue gift cards with an expiry date, reject redemption after expiry in the card's timezone and credit redemptions to the wallet.

title: Return Merchandise Authorisation
description: The Returns Management Service shall authorise returns within the return window, issue a return label and trigger the refund when the return is approved.

title: Overspeed warning before enforcement
description: When the train speed exceeds the authorised speed by more than TBC003 mph, the on-board segment shall display an overspeed warning and shall initiate a penalty brake application if the speed is not reduced within TBC008 seconds.

title: Consist data validation at initialisation
description: The on-board segment shall reject consist data with a missing or zero train length or weight and shall prompt the crew to re-enter the consist before initialisation completes.

title: Event recorder logging of enforcement
description: The on-board segment shall record every warning, penalty brake application and crew acknowledgement in the event recorder within TBC002 seconds, including speed, position and time.

title: Temporary speed restriction enforcement
description: The on-board segment shall enforce temporary speed restrictions received from the back office only on the track and milepost limits named in the bulletin, including restrictions with a start and end time.

title: Signal aspect decoding
description: The on-board segment shall decode each wayside signal aspect code using the configured aspect table and shall treat an unknown code as the most restrictive aspect.

title: Onboard power-on self-test
description: At power-on the on-board segment shall test the GPS antenna, radio, brake interface and display and shall report any failed item to the crew before initialisation.

title: Radio link loss annunciation
description: When no valid data message is received over the radio link for TBC045 seconds, the on-board segment shall annunciate radio link loss to the crew.

title: Crew login validation
description: The on-board segment shall accept a crew login only with a non-blank employee ID that is present in the crew list distributed by the back office.

title: Braking curve target calculation
description: The on-board segment shall calculate the braking curve target from the entered consist length and weight and shall not use default consist values once the crew has entered them.

title: Onboard configuration file checksum
description: The on-board segment shall verify the checksum of every configuration file at load and shall enter the FAILED state if any checksum does not match.

title: Departure test result reporting
description: The on-board segment shall report a departure test result only for a departure test that was actually performed, and shall not report a previously passed departure test as Failed when the locomotive system state is commanded to Non-controlling (1010) at the Begin Departure Test prompt. title: Departure test prompt handling on a state change
description: When the Begin Departure Test prompt is displayed and the on-board segment is commanded to Non-controlling, the on-board segment shall remove the prompt without recording a departure test result, and shall allow the departure test to be begun again during initialisation. (Sample wording based on the ECR; replace with the approved requirement text.)

title: Brake/Horn interface screen status fields
description: The on-board segment shall display the current Horn state on the Brake/Horn interface screen of the OB diagnostic screen, showing Active while the Horn key is pressed and Inactive otherwise. (Sample wording based on the ECR; replace with the approved requirement text.)

title: Horn state across control types and diagnostic screens
description: The on-board segment shall update the Horn state consistently for every supported control type, including SR-FLRT3-DMU and SR-KSS_EMU, on the Brake/Horn interface, EBI Slot 6 - EBI Onboard Diagnostics and System Test - Brakes screens.
